skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Calculate population and labor statistics indicators
Systematize appropriate statistical analysis methods for demographic studies
Identify statistical indicators for economic and social analysis and management
Evaluate and explain statistical analysis and forecasting models in demography and labor
Collect and select data for statistical analysis and forecasting in demography and labor
Construct and calculate population and labor statistics indicators
Use statistical tools and software in constructing and evaluating statistical analysis and forecasting models
Interpret results of analysis, compare with economic and social theories; analyze economic and social significance and evaluate policies to support decision-making
Have opinions and awareness about social context
Have critical thinking in solving problems
